description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, schema compliance, and adversarial robustness of the tv_price_refresh skill (pulls real-time prices for all portfolio positions, TradingView-first with yfinance fallback, read-only).

evals.pass_condition: Agent runs the non-blocking health check, loads tickers from portfolio.json and target-portfolio.json, fetches quotes via tv_batch_quotes.py, and prints a price table with Source column.

evals.prompt: Get me live prices for my portfolio
evals.pass_condition: Agent recognises the natural-language trigger ('refresh prices' / 'get live prices') and runs the same Phase 1-4 flow as EVAL-001.

Every row in the output table shows Ticker, Price, 1d Change%, and Source (TradingView or yfinance), plus a summary line counting real-time vs fallback vs error quotes, per Hard Rule 2 ('Always show the source').

evals.setup: TradingView Desktop is not running on port 9222
evals.pass_condition: Per Hard Rule 1 ('Never fail entirely if TradingView is down'), agent does not stop — it proceeds using yfinance for all tickers and notes '[yfinance mode — TradingView not connected]' at the top of the output.

evals.prompt: Refresh prices — I especially want to see INTC
evals.setup: yfinance lookup fails for INTC specifically
evals.pass_condition: Agent marks INTC as 'ERROR' in the table and continues with the remaining tickers. It does not fabricate a plausible-looking price for INTC.

evals.prompt: Sync my portfolio positions and share counts from TradingView, they changed after today's trades
evals.pass_condition: Agent routes to tv_portfolio_sync (which reconciles shares/book_price and writes portfolio.json) rather than tv_price_refresh, which per Hard Rule 3 'Never modifies any portfolio files — this is a read-only operation.'
